sources.reason: The zoo's official events page. It lists dates for seasonal family events like Fall at DZCA, Zoo Lights, Boo at the Zoo and Glowing Wild.

sources.name: Visit Denver – Mile High Holidays: Holiday Lights Events
sources.reason: Denver's official tourism guide to holiday light events for 2026, with dates and costs. It includes free shows like the Mile High Drone Shows and Light the Lights at the City & County Building, plus ticketed events.

sources.name: Denver Zoo – Scout Programs
sources.reason: Lists the zoo's seasonal scout programs for fall, winter and spring, with dates, prices and when registration opens.

sources.name: Front Range Community College – Westminster Campus
sources.reason: This is the official page for the community college campus in Westminster (3645 W 112th Ave). It covers campus life, including concerts and events that are open to the community, as well as program offerings. It is a nearby place for adults to look for skills classes and performances.

sources.name: FRCC Class Schedule
sources.reason: This is the official class search and registration page for FRCC terms. Adults can use it to find upcoming spring 2027 classes at the Westminster campus, sorted by subject and meeting days.

sources.name: FRCC Class Schedule FAQs / Continuing Education
sources.reason: This page mentions FRCC's Continuing Education department, which offers affordable noncredit professional development courses. It is the starting point for adult noncredit and skills courses near Westminster.

sources.name: Adams 12 Five Star Schools – District Calendar
sources.reason: Official district calendar with no-school days, board meetings (including school-closure hearings), and community and group events. It also links to the 2026-27 year-at-a-glance PDF.

sources.name: Adams 12 Five Star Schools Calendar (Tandem)
sources.reason: Searchable copy of the 2026-2027 Adams 12 calendar with holidays and team schedules. It may be easier to subscribe to than the main site.

sources.name: Five Star Online Academy – School Calendar
sources.reason: Adams 12 online school calendar listing upcoming school events and the 2026-27 important dates in English and Spanish.

sources.name: Westminster Public Schools – Calendars
sources.reason: Official WPS 'Coming Up' calendar with breaks, Board of Education meetings and district events such as the District Showcase.

sources.name: Westminster Public Schools – Summer Guide
sources.reason: WPS guide to summer activities, free summer meals and programs. Check here when 2027 summer options are posted.

sources.name: Westminster High School – News + Events
sources.reason: School news and events page for Westminster High School.

sources.name: Adams County – Events & Public Meetings
sources.reason: Official county calendar of festivals, community activities, Sheriff's Office (ACSO) events, webinars and public meetings, with upcoming dates.

sources.name: Adams County Parks, Open Space & Cultural Arts – Special Events
sources.reason: Yearly signature events at Riverdale Regional Park: Pride, Stars & Stripes (July 3), the County Fair, Festival Latino and the Dragon Boat Regatta & Night Market.

sources.name: Adams County Cultural Council Calendar

events.title: Girls Basketball League, Saturday Late Fall 2026 (ages 8–10, Westminster)
events.why: A youth basketball league in East Central Westminster that runs 5 Saturdays, 2026-11-07 to 2026-12-12. Registration should be open now, before it starts.

events.title: Denver Zoo Zoo Lights – tickets go on sale (members get early access Nov 2)
events.why: Tickets for this popular family holiday event go on sale Nov 5, and members get early access Nov 2. Adults cost $29.95 and youth $22.95, kids 2 and under are free, and value nights are cheaper.

events.title: Zoo Lights 2026 (Nov 23, 2026 – Jan 3, 2027, select nights)
events.why: More than a million lights across the zoo's 80 acres. Open select nights, closed on Thanksgiving and Christmas.

events.title: Mile High Drone Shows – free nightly holiday drone show, Tivoli Quad, Auraria Campus
events.why: Free. 600 drones fly every night at 7 p.m. from Nov 20 to Dec 31, 2026, and you can see the show from across the city.

events.title: 9NEWS Parade of Lights, downtown Denver
events.why: Free family parade with more than 40 units, including lit-up floats, giant balloons and marching bands. Grandstand seats near the City & County Building can be bought.

events.title: Light the Lights – free light and music show at City & County Building, Civic Center Park
events.why: Free 8-minute holiday light and music show every night at 5:45 and 6:45 p.m. The 2026 dates are not announced yet.

events.title: Zoo Lights Sensory-Friendly Night
events.why: A quieter Zoo Lights night with smaller crowds, low-volume music and quiet rooms. The date is not announced yet.

events.title: Zoo Lights Scout Night: Primate Palooza (registration opens late fall 2026)
events.why: Scout program for ages 3–15 that includes discounted Zoo Lights entry: $27 per scout, $32 per adult. Registration opens in late fall 2026.

events.title: ACSO Trunk or Treat – Clear Creek Valley Park (4–6 pm)
events.why: Free Halloween trunk-or-treat for kids, hosted by the Adams County Sheriff's Office.

events.title: Adams 12 school closures: open enrollment opens for families at affected schools
events.why: Local news report, not an official district page. Adams 12 plans to close 5–7 schools by August 2027. Families at affected schools get open enrollment starting Dec 1, 2026, with information sessions from Nov 2026 to May 2027.

events.title: Stars & Stripes Independence Day celebration – Riverdale Regional Park
events.why: Yearly county July 3 celebration (stated as every year on the third of July).

events.title: 2027 Adams County Fair (Aug 4–8, 2027)
events.why: Dates already announced. Large family fair with free shuttle service and free entertainment.
